brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres to confirm that blockage does not exceed one quarter of the free area before the forecast heat event, as outlined in SOP-015. For Camden Works 230/34kV, which has an ONAN cooling type, apply ambient de-rating according to MG-021 if the average ambient exceeds 30 degrees, and apply the further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward if the event extends beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees. Note that MG-025 specifies continuous overnight operation of forced cooling, but as this asset has ONAN cooling, that forced-cooling instruction does not apply.
